caption:
Scored a 0 or 1 on yesterday's turn test? Start here. 👇

1️⃣ Open Book: hips stacked, open the top arm with your breath
2️⃣ Split Stance Open Book: keep the pelvis square, turn through the ribs
3️⃣ T-Spine Flow: smooth, pain-free range, breathe through your nose

5 slow reps each side, daily for 2 weeks, then retest. Save this so you can find it tonight.
